mutations.contract: A total lands in the column it totals, to the pixel. `table-layout: fixed` plus the shared <colgroup> of the BODY table is what makes that true, and a second table below would be a second set of widths to keep in step with a column a reader can drag.
mutations.note: Only a real browser can see this: the DOM shim has no layout, so the same markup in a second table measures identically there. The mutation keeps every footer row and moves only which table they hang off.
